title: zetta.ComputeJob
description: One unit of native distributed accelerated compute (ARC-11 / ENT-31): featurize / train / explain / score / a DDF op, with a lifecycle (queued -> running -> succeeded | failed). A top-level, replicated entity (flat key job:<uuid>), modeled like zetta.Run. The id is the CRDT key / on-disk folder name and is optional in the value shape that rides in the document; it is present in the on-disk projection (<job-uuid>/job.json). The project / graph / run / scaling_policy refs are optional plain ids (a ScalingPolicy is the reward model — a separate entity slice; here it is only referenced by id). This file mirrors the inline schema in src/core/compute_job.cpp — keep the two in sync.

id.description: The job's UUIDv4 — the CRDT key (job:<uuid>) and on-disk folder name.

status.description: The lifecycle state. succeeded / failed are terminal.

scaling_policy.description: ScalingPolicy (reward) id (optional ref — the policy itself is a separate entity).

updated.description: ISO-8601 UTC stamp; bumped on every change.

detail.description: A human-readable note / failure reason, fit for display (optional).
